Commentary.Commentary: The visitors started the day by taking Chandimal and Mendis quickly. Dickwella and Mathews tried to counter attack but a brilliant catch to dismiss the latter and a false shot by the former got the better of them. For India, Ravichandran Ashwin was the pick of the bowlers bagging a 5-fer and he was well supported by the rest with everyone taking a wicket at least. On a wicket which is providing a lot of assistance to the bowlers we just might see the visitors clinching the series today. Join us for the second session in a while.
So Sri Lanka have been bundled out for 183. The Indian bowlers have made short work of the Sri Lankan batting line-up. They trail by 439 and INDIA HAVE ENFORCED THE FOLLOW-ON.

OUT! Dragged on! 26th fifer for Ashwin! He tosses it up outside off, Pradeep plants his front foot across and after feeling that the ball won't spin much tries to leave it. However, he is late in it and the ball takes the inside edge and rattles the stumps. That's the end of the Sri Lankan innings. THEY ARE BUNDLED OUT FOR 183! This is their lowest score against India at the SSC.
Pushpakumara dances down the track and heaves it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Pushpakumara dances down the track, but Ashwin cramps him for room by bowling an off spinner on the shorter side around off. Malinda adjusts well and chops it to point.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Pradeep prods forward in defence but gets a soft outside edge to second slip.
Pushpakumara gets across and works it on the leg side for a run.
Tossed up around off, spinning away, MP feels for it but gets beaten.

FOUR! Dropped and a boundary! Served fuller around off, spinning away. Pushpakumara goes for the slog again. Gets it off the toe end over mid on. Yadav there backpedals, gets both hands to it but ends up spilling it. The ball trickles to the fence behind. That was a difficult chance though!
Malinda now goes for the sweep against the turn but misses this time.
SIX! Slogged down the ground! Pushpakumara makes room and slogs the fuller delivery straight down the ground for a maximum. Take that Jaddu, says Malinda!
Nuwan sees off the over watchfully. Bends forward and blocks it again.
Slower through the air around off, Pradeep presents a front foot defence.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Pradeep prods forward and defends.
Nuwan Pradeep the last man comes out to bat. With only two minutes left before lunch if the last wicket does not fall in that time the session will be extended.

OUT! Ashwin gets through Perera's defence. Does him in with the flight. Lands it around off, Dilruwan looks to push it on the off side but plays down the wrong line. The ball goes past the inside edge and shatters the woodwork. 4th of the innings for Ashwin. He is continuing his good run.
Tossed up nicely around off, Dilruwan leans ahead to defend.
Ravichandran Ashwin is brought back into the attack.
MP prods forward and blocks it away.
A touch shorter and spinning away, punched off the back foot to mid on.
Malinda gets behind the line of the delivery and defends.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Quicker through the air around off, spinning away sharply. Pushpakumara prods forward to defend but the away spin and sharp bounce does him in.
Bangs it in short on off, Perera lets it through to the keeper.
Sprays on the pads, Pushpakumara flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Very full on middle, Dilruwan flicks it towards mid on for a run.
Good length on off, Perera defends it solidly.
Brilliant work from Jadeja! Full by Shami. Malinda drives it towards mid off where Ravindra dives to his right and makes a good stop, saving a certain boundary. The batsmen take a run.
Back of a length on off, Malinda guides it to point.
Quicker on off, gets vicious turn away from the batsman. Perera tries to defend but gets beaten.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
FOUR! He is continuing from where he left in Galle. Perera plays the slog sweep through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, Perera lets it through to the keeper.
Fires it full on middle, Pushpakumara gets it off the inner half through square leg for a run.
Bowls it wide outside off, Perera drives it through covers for a run.
Just ahead of a length on middle, Pushpakumara defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Bowls it on a length on off, Malinda defends it solidly.
Bangs it in short on middle, Pushpakumara tries to evade it but the ball hits his chest and lobs to second slip.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Good length on middle, Perera tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. The Indians appeal but the umpire gives it not out. The ball rolls on the off side and the batsmen take a run.
Lands it on a length on off, Perera defends it off the front foot.
Full outside off, Dilruwan drives it through mid off for a run.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. Shorter in length outside off, Perera cuts it through cover-point and the ball races to the fence.
FOUR! Dilruwan sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary. He used the pace well there.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Very full on middle, Perera digs it out well.
Advances down the track and pads it. The ball lobs towards second slip who collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. Had he hit it would have been interesting.
Malinda Pushpakumara comes out to bat.

OUT! Timber! Shami on fire! The perfect delivery for a tailender. He comes steaming in and spears it very full on middle and off, tails in sharply too. Herath is yorked and sees his woodwork disturbed. India just a couple wickets away from bowling out the hosts, depending on whether Pradeep comes out to bat.
Shami comes from over the wicket, bowls a back of a length delivery, angling away. Herath mistimes his punch through covers and collects a brace.
Banged in short, Herath ducks under it and lets it sail through to the keeper.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length delivery around off, angling in, Herath stands tall and blocks it away.
Rangana Herath strides out to the middle.

OUT! Dickwella oversmarts himself! Shami strikes with his first ball today. Niroshan kneels down and looks to scoop the length ball, gets a faint inside edge and it deflects onto the stumps. Such an unnecessary shot to play. He did all the hard work against the spinners, dealt with them nicely but in the end overdid himself, going after the first ball from Mohammed. SRI LANKA ARE STILL 472 RUNS BEHIND!
Mohammed Shami is into the attack.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Spinning away from outside off, tapped to point.
Outside off, watchful leave by the batsman.
Spinning into the pads, ND gets across and works it through square leg for a single.
Played with the spin on the leg side.
Spinning down leg, Dickwella gets across and lets it go at the last moment.

Stifled appeal for a catch! Perera looks to defend with bat and pad close but the ball takes the pads and lobs to short leg. India appeal but the umpire stays put. The Snicko confirms no inside edge and glove being involved.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

Missed chance! Spinning in from around off. Perera looks to defend but misses and the ball goes off the pads behind. He loses his balance and falls out of the crease. Saha though fails to collect the ball due to that deflection and the chance goes begging. Ashwin appealed for lbw too but it was turned down.
Shortish delivery outside off, spinning in, Perera goes back and punches it through covers for a brace. Good running!
Defended with the turn on the leg side.
5th Test fifty up for Niroshan Dickwella.

Another half century for Dickwella! His fastest one! He once again kneels down and plays a controlled sweep in front of square on the legs side for a single. This is his fourth fifty in 2017 and it is the most by a Lankan batsmen this year.
Spinning into the pads, Dickwella shuffles across and flicks it on the leg side for a single.
Eased through mid on for a single.
DP stays back in the crease and blocks it well.
Outside off, spinning away, Perera goes back to cut but the away turn and extra bounce does him in.

A muted appeal! Served around off, spinning away, Dilruwan feels for it but gets beaten on the outside edge. There's some sound as the ball passes the bat. The replays show that it was of the bat hitting the pad there.
Niroshan shapes to reverse sweep but gets it off the toe end through mid off for a single.
SIX! Into the stands! Game plan from Sri Lanka is clear, to go after the Indian bowling. This time it's Perera who gives the charge. Dances down and clobbers it over long on for a biggie.
Perera prods forward to defend but gets it off the inner half and onto the pads.
Ashwin comes from around the wicket, spinning away, ND goes back and taps it in the cover region for a single.
FOUR! Handsome! Fuller delivery on middle, Dickwella kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Spinning away, punched with the spin to covers.
Dickwella gets forward and eases it down to long on for a single.
This time ND fails to sweep it cleanly, the ball gets stopped by leg gully.
FOUR! Another one! Dickwella is doing well here to throw Jadeja off his lines and lengths. Kneels down and slog sweeps it over backward square leg for a boundary. He moves into the forties!
Dickwella goes back to punch but gets cramped for room by the ball spinning in. Adjusts well and defends it on the off side.
FOUR! Good use of the feet! Once again Dickwella dances down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and clubs it over mid on for a boundary.
Spinning into the pads, Niroshan kneels down across and sweeps it to square leg.
Drags his length back a little, Perera defends it off the back foot.
Connects with the sweep this time to deep square leg for a run.
Quicker on off, Dickwella guides it to point.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Dickwella brings out the sweep shot but gets beaten by the turn.
Tosses it outside off, Dickwella tries to sweep but misses and is struck on the pads.
Fires it on off, Perera drives it to mid off.
Dilruwan Perera walks out to bat.

OUT! 150th Test wicket for Jadeja! He is the second fastest Indian to do so.  Quicker on middle, turning away. De Silva tries to defend it off the front foot but gets beaten by the turn and the ball takes the off pole. That was a beautiful delivery. Not a good return for Dhananjaya as he bags a golden duck. The Sri Lankan batsmen are falling like a pack of cards. Jadeja gets his third.
Advances down the track and clips it to mid on to rotate strike.
Plays it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
FOUR BYES! Tries to play the reverse sweep but Jadeja fires it down the leg side. It misses everything and races down to the fine leg boundary.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Dhananjaya de Silva is the new man in.

Drinks break! Sri Lanka have lost half their side but are still 505 runs behind. They will have to pull something magical and also will need a lot of fortune if they want to get anything from this match. India would be looking to continue the same.

OUT! Sensational from Pujara! Great reflex catch there. Mathews can't believe it. Ashwin floats it on off, Angelo plays it with the spin towards leg gully where Pujara dives low to his left and takes an excellent one-handed catch. He starts walking back but the umpires ask him to stop. They go upstairs to check whether it is a clean catch or not. The replays show that he has taken that cleanly and Mathews has to walk back. Sri Lanka have half their side back in the hut. This is a huge wicket for India and you can see by their celebration how happy they are!
Pujara has take a stunner at leg gully. The umpire though wants to check it upstairs. However, the soft signal is 'out'.
Straighter one on leg stump, Niroshan plays it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Brings out the sweep this time, but hits it uppishly wide of the man at deep backward square leg who does well to pull it back just before the boundary. The batsmen take two.
Fires it on middle, Dickwella defends it off the back foot.
50-run stand is up between Dickwella and Mathews.
FOUR! Raining boundaries here. Shorter in length outside off, Dickwella cuts it through covers and the ball races to the fence.
Flatter on leg stump, turning away. Dickwella gets it off the outer half towards point.
Long off in place now. The attacking approach by these two batsmen has forced Kohli to think a little defensive.
SIX! BOOM! Counter-attack from the ex-skipper. Fires it on off, Mathews moves his front leg out of the way and smacks it straight over the fence for a huge maximum.
Sweeps it uppishly with the spin towards deep square leg for a run.
Fires it on middle, skids into the batsman, Mathews flicks it on the leg side for a run.
Flatter on off, turning away. Mathews tries to defend but gets beaten.
SIX! TOP SHOT! A lot fuller on leg stump, Mathews picks it up over mid on for another maximum.
Shorter in length on off, Mathews cuts it to point.
SIX! BANG! Great use of the feet. Dickwella runs down the track and hits it over the long off fence for a maximum.
Floats it on off, Mathews sweeps it uppishly to deep backward square leg for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Angelo defends it off the front foot.
Advances down the track and defends it.
Plays it with the spin towards mid-wicket. Dickwella wanted a run but was sent back by Mathews.
Sweeps it to deep backward square leg for a run.
Ravichandran Ashwin is now into the attack. Two slips, a leg slip and a silly point in place.
Darts it in on off, Mathews defends it by covering the line of the ball.
Drags his length back on off, Angelo pushes it through the off side for a couple.
Fires it on off, Mathews guides it on point.
Quicker on off, turning away. Mathews gets beaten.
Flatter on off, Angelo defends it off the front foot.
Shorter outside off, turning back in. Dickwella taps it towards covers for a run.
Full on off, Mathews drives it back to umesh who makes a good one hand stop to his right. He mimes to throw it back on the stumps but does not. Good aggression from Umesh.
Good length on middle, Mathews works it to mid-wicket.
Just ahead of a length on off, Mathews defends it off the front foot.
Huge appeal! Fullish length tailing back in on leg stump, Mathews tries to flick it but misses and is struck on the pads. The Indians appeal but the umpire gives it not out. It must be missing leg.
Bangs it in short on leg stump, Dickwella tucks it towards the leg side for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball.
Brings out the sweep shot again but this time the ball hits the back of the short leg fielder who was taking evasive action and the ball lobs towards square leg for a run.
FOUR! Dickwella will continue playing his shots. Walks across and sweeps it fine through the leg side for a boundary. If he would have missed that he would have been a dead duck.
Fires it on leg stump, Angelo taps it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter on off, Mathews defends it solidly.
Dances down the track and flicks it to the left of mid on for a run.
Plays it with the spin towards mid off for a run.
Angling into the batsman, played with the angle to mid on.
Length delivery, defended off the outer half to gully.
Back of a length delivery around off, Niroshan gets on his toes and blocks it.
FOUR! Nicely done! Dickwella opens the face of the bat and nicely glides it through backward point for a boundary.
Full outside off, driven on the up on the off side. Kohli at short cover drives and makes a good stop.
Full outside off, driven off the inner half to mid on.
FOUR! Good intent from Mathews! Shuffles across and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary. He picked his spot as there was no one out there.
Darts it in on middle, the batsman defends it solidly.
Fires it on off, Angelo defends it off the front foot.
That has taken a chunck out of the wicket! Fires it on off, turning away also bounces a lot. Mathews tries to defend it but gets beaten. Saha does well to collect it.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter on off, Mathews defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! Lovely timing! Full outside off, Dickwella leans into it and drives it through the covers for a boundary. He will play his shots.
Back of a length on middle, Dickwella defends it off the back foot.
Niroshan Dickwella walks out to bat.

OUT! UMESH STRIKES! Kohli having dropped one makes no mistake this time. Umesh bowls it on leg stump, Mendis tries to flick but the ball stops on him and takes the outer half and lobs up to mid on, who pedals back and takes an easy catch. Sri Lanka are in dire straits here.
Lands it on a length on off, Mendis defends it off the back foot.

CLOSE SHAVE! Lands it on a length on off, Mendis defends it off the bottom half and the ball bounces and hits him on the body and rolls just besides the stumps. Mendis does well to hit the ball away with his bat and not let it roll onto the stumps.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
FOUR! INNOVATION! Darts it on the stumps, Mathews paddles it through short fine for a boundary.

DROPPED! Jadeja is causing all sorts of problems here. Fires it in on the middle, turning away. Takes the outside edge of Mathews and goes to the left of second slip. Kohli positioned there first moves to his right and then dives low to his left, gets a hand to it but fails to hang on. Mathews gets a reprieve!
Beaten again! Quicker on off, turning away. Mathews tries to defend but gets beaten.
Arm ball on off, Mathews defends it solidly.
Flatter on off, turning away. Mathews is beaten as he tries to defend,
Angelo Mathews strides out to bat. These are testing time for Sri Lanka and they will need this experienced campaigner to fight it out in the middle.

OUT! Jadeja gets his man! Good field placement by Virat there. Full ball on leg stump, Chandimal shuffles across and sweeps it straight to Pandya at backward square leg, who takes an easy catch. He was the only man there and a couple of yards away from him could have fetched Dinesh a boundary but unfortunately he hit straight to Hardik. An early wicket for India and it is that of the skipper, who is walking back to the hut. The visitors are ecstatic!
Sprays on the pads, Mendis flicks it towards fine leg for a couple.
Good length outside off, Mendis shoulders his arms to it.
EDGED AND SHORT! Length ball on off, Mendis tries to defend but gets an outside edge which falls just short of Rahul at second slip. He makes a good stop though. Mendis has been lucky until now.
Back of a length on off, Mendis pushes it to point.
Lands it on a length on middle, Chandimal taps it towards mid-wicket for a run.
Fullish in length, swinging into the batsman. Chandimal drives it back to the bowler.
JAFFA! Quicker on off, turning away. Mendis tries to defend it but gets beaten. That was very close to the outside edge.
Fullish length, Mendis drives it to mid off.
Shorter in length on off, Mendis punches it to point.
Fires it on middle, turns away. Takes the outside edge of Mendis and on the bounce to first slip.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
TURN AND BOUNCE! Flatter outside off, turns away and also bounces extra. Mendis first wants to play the cut but then pulls out.
Fuller length outside off, Dinesh lets it through to the keeper.
Shorter in length on off, the batsman defends it solidly.
Good length on off, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
RIPPER! Fuller in length, swings away late. Chandimal tries to drive it but gets beaten. It almost took the edge. A great start by Yadav.
Back of a length on middle, Dinesh defends it off the back foot.

Induces an outside edge on his first delivery. Lands it on a length outside off, Chandimal tries to defend it but gets an outside edge on the bounce to second slip who dives to his right and stops the ball.
Umesh Yadav finally gets a go with the ball this innings!
Bowled on the pads, Mendis flicks it through the leg side for a couple. An eventful first over.

EDGY FOUR! Fires it on off, gets it to turn away from the batsman with extra bounce. Mendis is surprised by the bounce on offer and just puts his bat to it. Gets an outside edge and Pujara stationed at second slip fails to react and it goes between the first and the second slip for a boundary. Jadeja is not happy. That should have been taken. Che was standing too close.
Quicker on off, Dinesh taps it towards covers for a run.
Flatter on off, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.
Slower through the air, spinning away. The Lankan skipper lets it through to the keeper.
Tosses it up on off, Chandimal defends it off the front foot.

We're ready to get underway. The players and the umpires are out in the middle. Dinesh Chandimal and Kusal Mendis will continue their innings. Ravindra Jadeja will start the proceedings today morning.

A warm welcome everyone to day 3 of the second Test between Sri Lanka and India. The visiting side is in firm control of this game. After mounting a huge 622 runs on board, they now have got rid of the Lankan openers. Mendis and Chandimal then saw off the day but today will be their real test as the pitch would have deteriorated even more. The hosts will hope for this pair to bat as long as possible and release pressure for the batsmen to come. We are in for some great tussle between bat and ball today.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...

The pitch is providing a lot of assistance to the spinners and it will only get tougher for the batsmen. The Indian spinners will do the majority of the bowling tomorrow and try to get the purchase off the roughs, whereas Sri Lanka will bank on their experienced batsmen to get them out of this mess. Join us for Day 3 tomorrow at 1000 local (0430 GMT). Till then, cheers and take care!

So, India are in a commanding position heading into Day 3. Sri Lanka have lost both their openers with only 50 on the board and they still trail by another 572 runs. Ravichandran Ashwin is spinning a web around the Lankan batsmen and he already has two scalps to his name. Dinesh Chandimal and Kusal Mendis have taken the attacking approach and both will have to stitch a big partnership if the home side is to get close to the visitor's total.
Served in the line of the stumps, Mendis gets behind it and blocks. He survives the day as IT'S STUMPS ON DAY 2!

FOUR! That came out of nowehere! What a last over this is turning out to be for the hosts! 10 runs off it already. Tossed up around middle and off, Mendis kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Leg spinner on the shorter side of a length, Chandimal goes back and punches it through mid on for a single.
Leg bye! Lands it in the roughs, around off, spinning in. Mendis looks to defend but the ball spins in and lobs off Mendis' thigh pad past leg slip. A leg bye is taken.

FOUR! A rare boundary! Tossed up around off, spinning in, Mendis kneels down and goes through with slog sweep. Doesn't time it well but still gets enough behind it to get it through to square leg fence.
Full outside off, driven to covers.
Chandimal covers his stumps and defends it neatly.
DC prods forward and blocks it out.
Arm ball outside off, Chandimal gets across and lets it go through to the keeper.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
On middle, spinning away sharply, Chandimal defends it towards gully. The replays show that there was a huge puff of dust as the ball landed.
Mendis prods ahead and blocks it on the leg side.
Ashwin lands it in the roughs outside off, spinning in sharply. Worked with the spin towards leg slip. It goes on the bounce to Pujara. Mendis survives.
Mendis leans ahead and blocks it on the leg side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A carrom ball outside off, defended on the off side,
Mendis stays back and works it with the spin to short leg.
An unofficial drinks break. Kusal Mendis and Dinesh Chandimal have called for water to make the Indian spinners to slow down as they are bowling really quickly.
Around off, spinning away a touch, DC presents a solid front foot defence.
Chandimal takes a stride forward and pushes this fullish delivery on the off side.
Full outside off, pushed off the front foot to covers.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Beaten on the bounce! Landed around off, spins away with too much of bounce. Dinesh is surprised by it and drops his wrists to let it through.
Full around off, driven to short extra cover.
Spinning into the pads, Chandimal shimmies a touch and works it past leg slip for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Similar to the last delivery, DC stays back and adjusts to the turn, keeping it out.
Chandimal hangs back in the crease, lets the ball to come to him and then defends.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Beaten! Straighter one outside off, Chandimal looks to play for the spin. But, it's not there and whiskers past the bat. Good bowling, this!
Serves around off, spins a touch, squares Mendis up. The Lankan adjusts well and plays with an angled bat on the off side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Punched off the back foot with the spin to covers.
Full down the leg side, Mendis looks to defend it on the leg side but gets a leading edge past second slip.
Fuller around middle and off, Mendis remains solid in his defence.
Mendis backs away when Jadeja is about to deliver the ball. The umpire has a word with him and asks him to be ready when the bowler is.
Mendis leans ahead to defend but the away turn takes soft outside edge and goes on the bounce to second slip.
SIX! BANG! What a shot. Flighted ball on off, Chandimal gets down on one knee and sweeps it over the square leg fence for a biggie. That is one way to counter the spin.
Big turn! Floats it on off, Chandimal tries to defend it but the ball turns in and hits his thigh pad.
Dinesh Chandimal comes out to bat.

OUT! Ashwin strikes! The ball finally takes the outside edge. Karunaratne's struggle comes to an end. Ashwin tosses it up on off, the ball turns away and takes the outside edge to first slip where Rahane takes it comfortably. Sri Lanka are in deep trouble here. They have lost their second.
This has been the story of the today. He has beaten the edge so many times. Tosses it on off, turning away. Karunaratne tries to defend but gets beaten.
Bowls a slider on leg stump, Dimuth flicks it through short fine leg for a couple.
Tosses it up on off, Karunaratne defends it off the front foot.
Shortish delivery outside off, spinning away, chopped to point.
Jadeja lands it around off, spins away with sharp turn and bounce. Mendis is beaten in his defence.
Arm ball, sliding on, Mendis fails to read it and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Quicker through the air outside off, Mendis gets half forward to defend with soft hands but ends up edging it on the off side.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Shortish outside off, spinning away, Kusal goes back and punches it through cover-point for a brace.
This too spins away a touch but Karunaratne blocks it from within the crease.
Beaten again! Tossed up around off, spins away with bounce. Just what Ashwin has been doing throughout the innings. Dimuth feels for it and gets beaten.
Ashwin comes from around the wicket, lands it around middle and off, defended solidly.
Dimuth gets behind the line of the delivery and blocks it away.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Glorious! Full outside off, driven sweetly off the front foot straight down the ground. Gets it past mid off and to the fence behind.

NOT OUT! Such a waste of a review! Landed outside off, spinning away, Mendis prods forward to defend but is late in bringing his bat down and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire stays put. After a huge discussion, Kohli goes for the review. The Hawk Eye shows that the impact was outside off and going on to miss the stumps by a long way. India lose their first review.
There is a referral for LBW against Kusal Mendis. Looks like the impact is outside off.
Wide outside off, Mendis camps back and cuts it to point.
Landed outside off, padded away.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Outside off, punched to covers.
Karunaratne flicks it off the back foot square on the leg side for a single.
Spinning down leg, Mendis gets across to work it on the leg side but misses. Sharp turn beats him and raps him high on the pads.
Mendis dances down the track, to get Ashwin off his rhythm. However, it backfires as he misses his heave and gets rapped on the pads.

FOUR! More runs! Tossed up around off, Mendis kneels down to slog sweep but gets it off the inner half. Gets it in the gap and the ball races away to the mid-wicket fence. Trying to make Ashwin alter his line, is Kusal.
Served full on middle and leg, Dimuth shuffles across and tickles it in the square leg region for a single.
Pushed off the front foot to short cover.
Full outside off, spinning away, dabbed to gully.
Bowls it outside off, Kusal lets it through to the keeper.
Tosses it up on off, Mendis drives it to covers.

HUGE APPEAL! Flatter on the off, turns away from the batsman. Mendis tries to defend it but gets beaten. The Indian appeal but nothing from the umpire. Replays show that there was day light between bat and ball.
Drags his length back outside off, Mendis cuts it to cover-point.
Plays it with the spin towards fine leg for a run.
Comes over the wicket to the left hander. Comes down the track and defends it to silly mid on who collects the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. No harm done.

OVERTHROWS! Sliding into the batsman, flicked on the leg side. Pandya at mid-wicket, rushes to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. Had he hit, it would have been close. However, he doesn't and no backup allows the ball to race away to the fence. Five overthrows these, free runs for Dimuth Karunaratne!
Dimuth goes back and punches it square of the wicket on the off side for a brace.
Beaten again! Karunaratne looks to defend with a straight bat but the ball turns away a touch and whizzes past the outside edge.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Beaten again! Landed around off, spinning away, Karunaratne is surprised by the extra bounce and then drops his wrists at the last moment to leave.
Beaten! Ash lands it around off, gets it to spin away, Dimuth feels for it but gets beaten by the sharp away turn.
Fuller on middle, Kusal leans ahead and keeps it out.
Mendis once again presents a solid front foot defence.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full outside off, driven through covers. Dhawan there half stops it but the batsmen still don't go for the run.
Mendis prods ahead and buries it into the ground.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Ravindra Jadeja comes into the attack.
Once more! This time closer to the stumps. Karunaratne feels for it but gets beaten.
Beauty! Some sharp turn and bounce on offer! Ashwin lands it on off, spins away with bounce. Karunaratne prods forward in defence but gets beaten there.
Fuller on middle, Karunaratne shimmies and flicks it past Rahul at short leg. This time it's in front of square and gets a couple for it.
Full around off, DK prods ahead and blocks it.
On middle and off, straightening a touch, Karunaratne presents a front foot defence.
Slower through the air on middle and off, defended down the track off the front foot.
Length delivery, angling down leg, nudged past short leg behind square for a single.
Short around off, angling in, Karunaratne stands tall to defend but once again gets surprised by extra bounce. Ends up blocking it off the splice on the off side.
Banged in short, angling in, Dimuth ducks under it.
FOUR! Just a push! Full outside off, Karunaratne just leans into the shot and drives it through mid off for the first boundary of the innings. Beautiful to watch this!
Length delivery around leg, tucked towards short leg.
Angling into the pads, worked down the leg side for a single.
Spinning into the batsman this time. DK goes back and punches it on the off side.
Full around off, sliding in. Dimuth looks to clip it on the leg side but gets a leading edge towards backward point.
Landed around off, bounces a touch extra and spins away too. Karunaratne is surprised but does well to keep it out on the off side.
Spinning into the pads, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Served around off, straightening a touch, defended into the surface.
Fuller on middle and leg, clipped past short leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery, angling in, defended from within the crease.
A touch ahead of a length outside off, Mendis feels for it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Outside off, left alone.
Pushed from within the crease in the cover region for a single.
Once more Shami starts the over with a bouncer. Dimuth ducks and lets it through to the keeper. Saha has to jump to take.
Kusal Mendis strides out to the middle.

OUT! Rahul has managed to hold on to it! Slanting into the batsman, Tharanga stays back and works it on the leg side. Rahul at short leg hops to get out of harm's way. But, the ball hits him on the shoulders and deflects into his stomach region and he manages to hang on to it. He is up in celebration and then Kohli joins him. Both perform a combined dab. One can feel for Tharanga, such an unlucky dismissal! Ashwin has drawn first blood. He has the highest dismissals (95) by a spinner, opening the bowling (1 or 2) for his side.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Bowls an arm ball, quicker through the air. Upul keeps it with a block.
Beaten! Serves it on middle and off, grips and turns away sharply. Tharanga prods forward in defence but gets beaten.
Ashwin gives it a nice loop and lands it full around off, it's driven to mid off.
Served around off, straightening a touch, defended on the off side.
Ravichandran Ashwin will bowl from the other end.
Fuller around off, kept out from within the crease.
Pitched outside off, guided to gully.
Angling into the batsman, tucked to mid-wicket.
Length delivery outside off, Dimuth hangs his bat and dabs it on the off side.
On a good length and angling in, tucked to mid-wicket.
What a start! That just took off from the surface! Shami comes steaming in and bangs it in short, angling into the batsman. Karunaratne ducks under it to let it go.
